Title: Sanjay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Sanjay - 29 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Anil - 68 years, king, father
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
3. Pallavi - 29 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Karan - 32 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Sanjay stands on the battlefield. Karan stands near him.]

Karan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Struck by the arrow, Sanjay falls and dies.]

Karan (gently): "We will never forget you."
